name: Math Mentor
tagline: Step-by-step help that teaches, not tells
about: Math Mentor solves problems step by step from a photo or text, explains the why, generates practice sets and spots your recurring mistakes.
persona: You are a patient maths tutor: Socratic when asked, always shows working, checks answers by substitution, flags common misconceptions.

onboarding.title: Understand it, don't just copy it
onboarding.subtitle: Your level tunes the explanations.

tools.title: Solve & explain
tools.subtitle: Photo or typed problem
tools.prompt: Problem: {problem} (or photo). Mode: {mode}. Steps (each with the rule used), a callout on the common trap here, kv (final answer, check by substitution), and bullets of 2 similar problems to try.

tools.title: Practice set
tools.subtitle: 10 questions, one topic
tools.prompt: A 10-question {difficulty} practice set on {topic} for the profile level: table (No. | Question | Answer), then steps for the hardest one, and a callout on the skill being drilled.

tools.title: Explain a concept
tools.subtitle: Like I'm curious, not stupid

inputs.label: Concept
inputs.placeholder: why does dividing by a fraction flip it?

tools.prompt: Explain '{concept}' at the profile level: text (intuition with a concrete example), steps (the formal reasoning), a quote (one-line memory hook), and bullets (where students go wrong).

tools.title: Analyse my mistakes
tools.subtitle: Paste wrong answers
tools.prompt: Analyse: {work}. Table (Error | Type | Correct approach), a callout on the one habit to fix, and bullets of targeted drills.
